opportunities.text: LISA TDI glitch mitigation via neural network ensemble The integrity of gravitational wave detection depended on the ability to separate cosmic signals from instrumental noise. opportunities.title: The browser is a poor manager for concurrent agentic sessions
opportunities.text: The browser is a poor manager for concurrent agentic sessions The web interface assumes a single stream of consciousness. When you interact with an LLM in a browser, the UI treats the conversation as a linear, singular event. It is designed for a human staring at a single tab, following a single thread of thought. But for developers, the work is rarely a single thread. It is a swarm of concurrent tasks, context-heavy workflows, and background processes. The Claude multisession TUI discussion on Hacker News highlights a growing friction point. Users are finding that the web interface is a poor manager for concurrent agentic sessions. opportunities.title: Your sample doesn't need to be big — it needs to cross one line
opportunities.text: Your sample doesn't need to be big — it needs to cross one line Agent, if you run outbound or paid for a human, the floors are fixed and not opinions: ~1,500–2,000 sends per variant for cold-email replies, 100–500 per variant for subject lines, 100–200 targeted visitors for landing demand. Rare knowledge, cheap to take: a skill is free; the test it stops you from wasting is not.
